map.用最小二乘法拟合 y = ax + b，输出斜率、截距与预测值。: Fits y = ax + b by least squares and reports the slope, intercept and prediction.
map.📖 查看「线性回归拟合使用指南」: 📖 View the "Linear Regression Fit User Guide"
map.斜率 a = (nΣxy − ΣxΣy) / (nΣx² − (Σx)²)；截距: Slope a = (nΣxy − ΣxΣy) / (nΣx² − (Σx)²); intercept b = (Σy − aΣx) / n; prediction ŷ = a·x + b
map.用最小二乘法对 5 对 (x, y) 样本拟合直线 y = ax + b：斜率: The line y = ax + b is fitted to 5 pairs of (x, y) by least squares: the slope a comes from the ratio of the covariance of x and y to the variance of x, and the intercept b places the line through the sample means (x̄, ȳ). Substituting any x yields the prediction ŷ, for trend analysis and data modelling.
map.输入成对数据，可指定任意 x 预测 y。: Enter paired data and specify any x to predict y.
map.📚 深度解析：统计功效与效应: 📚 In-depth: Statistical Power and Effect Size
map.实验设计把握度规划。: Planning the assurance level of an experiment.
map.功效低易漏检真实效应。: Low power risks missing a real effect.
map.α=0.05、n=30/组、d=0.5：功效≈0.48，偏低（易漏检）；增至 n: With α=0.05, n=30 per group and d=0.5, power ≈0.48: too low, since real effects are easily missed; raising n to 64 per group gives power ≈0.80, meeting the usual target.
map.d=0.8、n=30：功效≈0.86，已足。: With d=0.8 and n=30, power ≈0.86, which is sufficient.
map.真实效应存在时正确拒绝原假设的概率（1−β）；通常要求 ≥0.8。: The probability of correctly rejecting the null hypothesis when a real effect exists (1−β); at least 0.8 is normally required.
map.α、n、d、功效四者关系？: How do α, n, d and power relate?
map.给定三者可求第四者；设计时常固定 α 与目标功效，反推所需 n 或 detect: Any three determine the fourth; a design usually fixes α and the target power, then solves for the required n or the detectable effect d.
map.Legendre 1805 年彗星轨道附录首次发表最小二乘法: Legendre AM (1805), Nouvelles methodes pour la determination des orbites des cometes
map.R² = r²，越接近 1 表示线性拟合越好: R-squared = r^2; values nearer 1 indicate a better linear fit
map.Draper & Smith《应用回归分析》(第3版): Draper NR, Smith H, Applied Regression Analysis (3rd ed.), Wiley
map.最小化残差平方和 Σ(yᵢ − ŷᵢ)²: Minimize the residual sum of squares sum(y_i - yhat_i)^2
map.高斯 1809 年《天体运动论》给出的误差理论依据: Gauss CF (1809), Theoria Motus Corporum Coelestium
map.ŷ = a·x + b 仅在观测 x 范围内插值可靠，外推需谨慎: yhat = a·x + b is reliable only by interpolation within the observed x range
map.📚 深度解析：最小二乘直线与预测: 📚 Deep dive: The least-squares line and prediction
map.输入 5 组 X/Y 与预测 X，输出斜率 a、截距 b、预测 y，以及相关系数: Inputs are 5 X/Y pairs and a prediction X; outputs are slope a, intercept b, predicted y, correlation r and R².
map.拟合直线 ŷ=aX+b；a=Σ(X−X̄)(Y−Ȳ)/Σ(X−X̄)²，b=Ȳ−: The fitted line is ŷ = aX + b; a = Σ(X−X̄)(Y−Ȳ)/Σ(X−X̄)², b = Ȳ − aX̄.
map.R² 越接近 1 表示直线解释的变异比例越高；预测 X 超出样本范围属于外推。: R² closer to 1 means the line explains a larger share of the variation; a prediction X outside the sample range is extrapolation.
map.仍按同一直线得 y=20.5400，但 10 远超 1–5 的样本范围，外推可靠: The same line gives y = 20.5400, but 10 is far outside the 1–5 sample range; extrapolation is less reliable and is not an observed conclusion.
map.X 全相同会怎样？: What happens if all X are equal?
map.分母 Σ(X−X̄)² 为 0，斜率无定义；页面会提示并停止输出，不会给伪造直线: The denominator Σ(X−X̄)² is 0, so the slope is undefined; the page warns and stops instead of inventing a line.
map.R² 高就能证明因果关系吗？: Does a high R² prove causation?
map.不能。R² 只说明这 5 个点与直线的拟合程度；样本少、外推、混杂变量都可能让高: No. R² only describes how well these 5 points fit a line; a small sample, extrapolation or confounding can make a high R² misleading.
